v0.2.description:
## Locations
* Apples
* Horses in the glue factory

## Items
* Apples
* NPC Unlocks
* Tooth Sharpener (allows for wire cutting to free horses in the glue factory)

## Goal
* Can pick one of two:
  * A customizable number of apple items received gives access to finish
  * A customizable number of apple locations checked gives access to finish.
* For either goal can optionally require freeing the horses in the glue factory

## Other Features
* Set a custom number of apples to access each area

## Downloads
BepInEx download: [BepInEx 5.4.23.x, `BepInEx_win_x64`](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)

Setup:
1. Find the game folder: in Steam, right click the game, then
   Manage -> Browse local files.
2. Extract BepInEx into that folder, so `winhttp.dll` sits next to
   `Horse Riding Classic.exe`. Launch the game once and quit, which creates the
   `BepInEx/` subfolders.
3. Extract the plugin zip into the same game folder. It is laid out to merge, so
   the plugin lands in `BepInEx/plugins/`.
4. Once you have a multiworld to connect to, open the game and connect. Press F1 to hide the connection window.
